Use Case Name Export courses Author Trần Văn Bình Date 09/08/2020 Priority High Actor: - Admin Summary: - This use case allows admin to export a list of courses in Excel file d download. Goal: - admin could download a file which contains a list of course. Triggers: - admin sends a request to the system to get list of courses. Preconditions: - A user login to the system as admin role. - A course, which needs to be export, exists in the database. Post Conditions: - Success: A list of courses in the database is saved in excel file d is allowed to be downloaded by the user . - Fail: Can't download the excel file. Main success scenario: Step Actor Action System Response 1 Admin sends command to system go get data. The system gets a list of courses in database and save in excel file and then download to user’s computer . [Exception 1] Alternatives: N/A Exceptions: Step Actor Action System Response

Goal: - User can chat with class participants. Triggers: - User sends a chat command. Preconditions: - User has login into system with role Student or Lecturer - User has joined the classroom. Post Conditions: - Success: User can chat with each other . - Fail: User can’t chat with another participant. Main success scenario: Step Actor Action System Response 1 User goes to chat view The system displays a chat view to the user and gets all participants in the room. 2 User selects chat one or chat many. 3 User enters a message to the chat box. 4 User sends message commands The system gets request from user: - If user selects a chat one – one, the system displays the message only for the participant that is chosen. The system required information from user: + Participant Id: text, required. - If user selects a chat one – many, the system displays the message for all participants. [Exception 1] Alternatives: N/A Exceptions: Step Actor Action System Response
